details.title: Business details
details.description: Set your business name, tax and language preferences, and manage external links.

edit.title: Edit business details
edit.businessInfoHint: Choose the name displayed on your online booking profile, sales receipts and messages to clients.
edit.linkInvalid: Enter a valid link, e.g. instagram.com/yoursite
edit.taxHint: Choose how to apply taxes to prices in sales and reporting calculation.
edit.taxExclusiveHint:
Tax = Retail * Tax
e.g. 20% tax on a €10 item costs €2
edit.taxInclusiveHint:
Tax = (Tax rate * Retail price) / (1 + Tax rate)
e.g. 20% tax on a €10 item costs €1.67
edit.languageHint: Choose the default language for clients and team members.
edit.languageNote: Team members and clients can override the language displayed to them in their settings.
edit.linksHint: Add your company website and social media links for sharing with clients.
edit.languagePickerHint: Choose the language used by default.

locations.deleteBody: {{name}} will be removed. Team members, services, resources and registers will no longer be assigned to it. This can't be undone.
locations.shareHint: Share your booking link so clients can book your full service menu online.
